explication: Real-ESRGAN is an image/video restoration and super-resolution system. The main user workflow is: select media and a model, load weights, run tiled or whole-image enhancement, optionally enhance faces, and write restored images or encoded video. A second major workflow trains models from synthetic degradations or paired data using BasicSR. The graph includes documented anime/general models, video processing, arbitrary scaling, and optional GFPGAN integration. Some orchestration is inferred from sampled entrypoints and README capabilities; unsampled BasicSR internals are left external.
